SMALL CLAIMS HEARING OF JUN-10-2021 - CONTINUED FOR PROGRESS REPORT TO JUL-13-2021 AT 10:00 AM IN DEPT. 506. PLAINTIFF SETH MARRA IS PRESENT. DEFENDANTS FUN YUI WANG, AKA LUCY WANG, JIM WANG, EVA WANG ARE PRESENT THROUGH JOHN WANG (DC-109 FILED) DEFENDANT JOHN WANG IS PRESENT ON HIS OWN BEHALF. COURT DETERMINES THAT PLAINTIFF IS OWED $1,050.00 IN RETURNED SECURITY DEPOSIT AS WELL AS COURT COST OF $301.75 (FILING OF PLAINTIFF'S CLAIM AND PROOF OF SERVICE AS TO ALL DEFENDANTS). TOTAL AMOUNT OWED TO PLAINTIFF IS $1,351.75. DEFENDANT AGREES TO MAIL A CHECK TO PLAINTIFF FOR SAID AMOUNT. PROGRESS REPORT DATE IS SET FOR JULY 13, 2021 AT 10:00 A.M. NO APPEARANCE IS REQUIRED IF PAYMENT IS MADE AS AGREED AND THE MATTER WILL BE DISMISSED WITH PREJUDICE AS SETTLED. IF PAYMENT IS NOT MADE AS AGREED, AN APPEARANCE IS REQUIRED AND JUDGMENT WILL BE ISSUED. PLAINTIFF AND DEFENDANT EXHIBITS ARE REVIEWED AND RETURNED IN OPEN COURT. JUDGE: MICHELLE TONG; CLERK: W. TRUPEK. NOT REPORTED.(506)

THE COURT ORDERS DISMISSAL OF THE ENTIRE ACTION WITH PREJUDICE. CASE SETTLED. NO APPEARANCES BY PLAINTIFF SETH MARRA. NO APPEARANCES BY DEFENDANT FUN YUI WANG. JUDGE: MICHELLE TONG; CLERK: W. TRUPEK. NOT REPORTED.(506)
